resolvedMechanisms: The AI mapper changed from /AI/ to a word-bounded AI or Chinese explicit-term pattern, removing all nine prior spurious GenAI attachments in this review subset.
When a specific regex matches, module default sources are no longer appended, which removed many unrelated fallback citations.
New targeted mappings for strong inference, selection bias, standard error, confidence intervals, interaction, leakage, time origin, C-index, ORA, and related methods closed claim-level mismatches.
remainingMechanisms: Git still maps to FAIR, which does not define commit/branch/diff semantics.
Generic paper/literature terms still map to PRISMA, leaving course-specific evidence-chain and literature-extraction rules only weakly supported.
Kaplan/log-rank maps to Kaplan-Meier and censoring sources but still lacks a direct log-rank source.
Sample size reasoning maps to a power critique that does not support the full multivariable sample-size rule.

metadataItems.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
metadataItems.note: The prior missing DOI/PMID/title/type issue is closed.
Each source has a verified title, year, type, DOI or other stable identifier, and recorded core evidence. src-power has a DOI and publisher URL; absence of a PMID is not by itself a metadata defect.

blockers.issue: Claim-source mismatch remains after the final diff.
blockers.action: Do not activate these claims; replace or narrow the claim, or add a direct method/original source.
Even evidence-ready claims require an explicit claim-level approval transition before activation.

majors.issue: The boundary correctly discloses curriculum synthesis, but source core evidence covers only part of the rule.
majors.action: Keep these as pending-review candidates; add targeted sources or narrow the unsupported clauses.

majors.issue: Broad regex mappings for Git, paper/literature, log-rank, and sample-size reasoning remain semantically under-specific.
majors.action: Use narrower patterns or explicit topic sourceIds and add direct sources before claim approval.
